prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: a trodden snowy path: packed snow with footprints and a little frozen mud showing The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Generate a square seamless tileable top-down JRPG ground texture, a trodden snowy path consisting entirely of packed snow, scattered small footprint impressions, and sparse frozen mud patches showing through. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art with deliberate hand-placed, crisp uniformly sized square pixels, about 32x32 art-pixel grid scaled up nearest-neighbor to ~256x256 displayed pixels (each square ~8x8 displayed pixels). Distinct readable clusters of 3–10 art pixels; no subpixel marks. Snow in 4–6 earthy pale cream/blue-gray hues, warm yellow highlights, more saturated muted purple-red shadow hue; mud 4–6 earthy brown/plum shades. Footprints subtle, varied, irregularly dispersed and partly filled with snow, no obvious repeated central feature; evenly distributed detail throughout. Classic steep top-down orthographic RPG map view. Neutral soft even upper-left overcast-evening base lighting, no cast shadows, no lighting effects. EXACT seamless periodic texture: left-edge snow/mud/footprint shapes continue at right edge, top-edge features continue at bottom edge, matching edge pixels. Fill all edges with the ground texture. No border, frame, objects, characters, text, vignette, glow, night darkness, gradients, anti-aliasing, blurring, soft brushwork, photorealism, random noise, or checkerboard dithering.
